text:
rachel.pm: Quick announcement — Hosted Agent Orchestrator is GA today. New unified hosted endpoint: /v3/orchestrator. :tada:

rachel.pm: It combines streaming generation + managed tool orchestration + safe fallbacks in one API surface aimed at conversational agents and assistants.

yves.eng: Implementation note: this sits above our existing runtimes; no kernel changes. We shipped an orchestration layer that sequences streaming frames, handles tool handoffs, and enforces idempotency for retries.

anita.docs: Docs + migration guide posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/orchestrator/migrate — includes Node/Python SDK examples and a small sample agent app.

mike.sre: Rollout plan: internal preview -> 15% hosted traffic -> 60% -> 100% over 48h with monitoring gates. Canary started at 1959990600. Monitoring dashboards added for p50/p95, tool-error-rate, and connection churn.

rachel.pm: Deprecation: /v2/agent-run will be supported for 90 days. We'll surface in-app banners and send customer comms.

yves.eng: GA limits for now: max_tools_per_request=6, idle_stream_timeout=9m, tool_call_timeout=50s. We'll loosen limits after initial telemetry.

cara.support: CS KB and canned responses uploaded: https://internal.redwood/kb/orchestrator-ga — CS checklist included.

anita.docs: Migration snippet (Python):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.orchestrator.stream(
  model='mosaicx-lite-2',
  prompt='Assist and call tools when necessary',
  tools=[{"name":"lookup","url":"https://svc.internal/lookup"}],
):
  print(chunk.text, end='')
```

mike.sre: Jenkins: orchestrator v1.0 deployed to hosted pools at 1959990800. Health checks green.

rachel.pm: Action items — ENG: monitor p95 & tool failures 0-72h (cc @yves.eng, @mike.sre); DOCS: add FAQ about tool auth (cc @anita.docs); SUPPORT: schedule customer emails and in-product banner (cc @cara.support). Ping here for major regressions. Great work team! :rocket:
